from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit


def parse_dsn(url: str) -> dict:
    """Descompone una URL de conexión. Ver README."""
    u = urlsplit(url)
    scheme = u.scheme
    port = u.port
    if port is None and scheme in ("postgres", "postgresql"):
        port = 5432
    db = u.path.lstrip("/") or None
    return {
        "scheme": scheme,
        "user": unquote(u.username) if u.username else None,
        "password": unquote(u.password) if u.password else None,
        "host": u.hostname,
        "port": port,
        "database": db,
    }
